# Workflow artifact

The CLI consumes the exact npm release `@robota-sdk/workflows` 0.0.7 as a build-time dependency (`devDependencies` of `packages/agent-cli/package.json`) and bundles it with its host-owned SDK. The lockfile entry `/@robota-sdk/workflows@0.0.7` in `pnpm-lock.yaml` pins the registry tarball by its integrity value `sha512-yIuArJGj9fnzbq43cNZKheZwJny4Mo77nEmplp8q+VOrDwllnfAtII75a+K84+y2jVll9IDeKN30HXwICsDlbg==`, which is the `dist.integrity` the npm registry reports for that version. The release is built from the workflow source revision recorded in the package's own `SOURCE.md` (`https://github.com/robota-io/robota-workflows`). Its SDK peers (`agent-core`, `agent-framework`, `agent-interface`, `agent-provider`, `agent-tools`) are `~3.3.0`.

Before an SDK package that the workflow artifact peers on is released at a version outside `~3.3.0`, qualify an SDK workspace with a workflow artifact whose peer ranges admit that exact version. Verify generated product workspaces, frozen installation and host authority identity for the new combination before merging the pin change. Update and review the workflow artifact first when its peer ranges do not admit the next SDK version. Package publication, tags and deployment are separate release steps.

To roll back the pin, change the version in `packages/agent-cli/package.json` and the lockfile together. Do not assume an older workflow artifact supports the host SDK, and do not alter saved workflow data as part of rollback.
